claim: A regret-based query selector for active learning matches or outperforms other selection criteria (e.g., uncertainty sampling) at collecting reward across all bandwidth availability levels in simulation.
falsifier: In a simulated environment with varying bandwidth, compare the reward collected by a robot using regret-based query selection against other active learning heuristics.

conditions: simulation configurations with varying bandwidth availability
exclusions: limited to the reported simulation configurations and conditions; transfer beyond them is unestablished

title: Regret-based query selection for reward collected per mission
